reconstructed_captions.24: The man in the patterned sweater walks towards a pile of branches on the forest floor.
reconstructed_captions.25: He bends down and picks up a large, sturdy branch.
reconstructed_captions.26: He carries the branch back towards the area in front of his tent.
reconstructed_captions.27: He lays the branch down on the mossy ground.
reconstructed_captions.28: He turns and walks back towards the pile of branches to get more.
reconstructed_captions.29: He selects another large branch from the pile.
reconstructed_captions.30: He picks up the second branch and turns back towards his tent.
reconstructed_captions.31: He carries the second branch over to where he placed the first one.
reconstructed_captions.32: He places the second branch on the ground next to the first.
reconstructed_captions.33: He gathers a few more smaller sticks and places them with the large ones.
reconstructed_captions.34: Having gathered enough wood, he kneels down on the ground.
reconstructed_captions.35: He begins to sort and arrange the large sticks he has gathered on the ground.
